name: @agntux/agntux-build-mcp-server
description: agntux-build MCP server. Runs the build/validate/render/marker pipeline INSIDE the host-spawned MCP server process (native macOS, full filesystem, real Chromium) instead of the restricted Bash sandbox. Exposes agntux_validate, agntux_write_submission, agntux_confirm_submission as atomic tools the build skill orchestrates — nothing the model can hand-emulate or fabricate. Zero runtime npm dependencies (raw stdio JSON-RPC 2.0); imports the shared toolchain from ../bin and ../host-renderer.

scripts.syntax-check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/bootstrap-worker.js && node --check build.js
